cards.title: Nonlinear separated-coordinate conformal calibrations
cards.card_text:
N888-nonlinear-separable-conformal-calibration | Nonlinear separated-coordinate conformal calibrations
status=source_derived_unreviewed; supplied claims and internal work remain externally unreviewed.

Unchanged J_r for every r>0, every real s, periodic phi=(F(x)+H(y),g(x,y)); arbitrary W1,4 F,H and unrestricted compatible W1,4 g. A broader stress-conservation class is quantified at its fixed r,s.

Exact statement: Exact nonlinear row stresses and rational positive Gram identities prove Jensen gap >=5r<|Dphi|^4>/[4096(r+2)]+r*s^2<a^2+c^2+d^2>/[512(r+2)] for every r>0. The separate r1 certificate gives the stronger bounds 1/256 and s^2/128. The stresses are divergence-free for the stated two-profile first potential. A one-phase nonseparated example has prior qualitative triangular-support coverage. Exact general mixed sources and a reserve-floor falsifier are preserved; no unrestricted positive-core QC theorem follows.
Proof spine: See exact hash-pinned analytic derivations, independent receiving audits and separately scoped finite certificates below.
Costs and information: Continuum exact-gradient estimates do not supply a sharp solver or acquired physical parameters. Rational witness enumeration is exponential; full conditioning, precision, acquisition and reset costs remain charged.
Comparator/originality: Classical interpolation, Hodge/null-Lagrangian/SOS tools and primary predecessors are credited; no historical novelty clearance.
Failure and missing obligation: Construct a nonlocal or richer correction controlling the exact general mixed-source pairing against the full Gram budget, or exhibit a compatible negative Jensen field. Seek external review/priority. Separation cannot be silently removed.

Internally derived/reconstructed analytic arguments and exact finite checks are separate. All new high-impact claims remain source_derived_unreviewed. External correctness, historical priority, physical acquisition, formal verification and practical advantage are UNKNOWN. Metadata, Git integration and same-team agreement do not establish those statuses.
